melder.aether.conduit.creations.managed_.role: Module holding ManagedSpellLease, one leased managed object and its way back.
responsibilities: exports ManagedSpellLease and the ManagedObjectT type variable that ReleaseManagedSpell.managed and Conduit.managed_spell_meld are typed with

melder.aether.conduit.creations.managed_.label: ManagedSpellLease
melder.aether.conduit.creations.managed_.role: One object leased from a managed spell's pool, paired with that pool so it is given back exactly once.
responsibilities: holds the leased object and its pool, both borrowed; created by ReleaseManagedSpell.managed and Conduit.managed_spell_meld

release() gives the object back once (pool.put_back: the resets, then idle for the next lease) and drops both references; later calls do nothing, and the lease counts as released even when the put-back raised, so nothing goes back twice
object answers the leased object until the lease is released, then raises RuntimeError; `with lease as obj:` binds it and the exit releases it whether or not the block raised, never suppressing
a class, not a generator (a generator context manager measured about 600 ns more per use); one lease is not thread-safe, different leases are independent

edges_authored.why: The lease gives its object back through the pool's put_back exactly once, then drops both references.
